mild.reference: If things ever feel too heavy, people are available to talk to, for free. You can find them anytime under Get help.

danger.full:
It sounds like you're carrying something really painful right now, and I'm glad you wrote it down. You don't have to face this alone — the people listed under Get help are available to talk right now, for free.

Aap akeli/akele nahi hain — Get help mein diye gaye log abhi aapki madad kar sakte hain.
danger.abbreviated:
You don't have to carry this alone. People are available right now under Get help.

Madad maujood hai — Get help dabayein.

emergency.full:
Your safety matters most right now. If you are in immediate danger or have taken something, call Rescue 1122 now. You can also call one of the helplines below — they are free and they will listen.

Agar aap is waqt khatre mein hain, abhi 1122 par call karein.
